# NM Technology Integrated Solutions — Full AI Reference

> NM Technology is Albuquerque, New Mexico's premier low voltage systems integrator and security solutions provider. We install, service, and maintain CCTV surveillance cameras, fire alarm systems, access control systems, burglar alarm systems, and structured network cabling for commercial and residential clients across New Mexico.

---

## Company Overview

NM Technology Integrated Solutions is a locally owned and operated low voltage contractor based in Albuquerque, New Mexico. We are a fully licensed, insured, and bonded contractor specializing in the design, installation, service, and integration of electronic security and life safety systems. Our NFPA-certified technicians deliver code-compliant solutions for businesses, government facilities, schools, healthcare providers, and homeowners throughout the state.

**Website**: https://nmtechnology.us
**Primary Location**: Albuquerque, NM
**Business Type**: Low Voltage Systems Integrator / Security Contractor

## Services in Detail

### 1. CCTV Surveillance Camera Systems
NM Technology installs and services commercial and residential security camera systems throughout Albuquerque and New Mexico.

**Capabilities:**
- IP camera system design and installation
- Network Video Recorder (NVR) and Digital Video Recorder (DVR) configuration
- Remote video monitoring and mobile app setup
- PTZ (pan-tilt-zoom) camera installation
- License plate recognition (LPR) camera systems
- Thermal imaging cameras
- Camera system maintenance, repair, and upgrades
- Cloud-based and on-premise video storage solutions
- Integration with access control and alarm systems
- Parking lot and perimeter surveillance
- Indoor and outdoor camera installation
- Multi-location video management systems

**Brands & Technologies:** Hikvision, Dahua, Axis, Hanwha, Verkada, Milestone, Genetec, Avigilon

### 2. Fire Alarm Systems
NM Technology designs, installs, inspects, and services fire alarm systems in compliance with NFPA 72 and New Mexico State Fire Marshal regulations.

**Capabilities:**
- Addressable and conventional fire alarm system installation
- Fire detection and notification system design
- Smoke detector and heat detector installation
- Fire alarm pull station installation
- Horn/strobe notification appliance installation
- Fire alarm annunciator panel installation
- Annual fire alarm inspection and testing
- Fire alarm system monitoring (UL Listed central station)
- Fire alarm system repair and troubleshooting
- Fire sprinkler monitoring integration
- Emergency voice/alarm communication systems (EVACS)
- Mass notification systems
- New Mexico State Fire Marshal compliance and documentation
- Fire alarm system certification

**Codes & Standards:** NFPA 72, NFPA 101, IBC, New Mexico Fire Code, ADA compliance
